title: Extract the original MAV-Celeb v1 / v2 zips exactly as the Kaggle dataset chnnhnnguyn/external-data-mavceleb

compute.platform: Linux / Docker (on Kaggle attach the public dataset chnnhnnguyn/external-data-mavceleb instead: /kaggle/working holds about 20 GB)

origin.notes: the public dataset chnnhnnguyn/external-data-mavceleb was made by uploading the two organisers' zips; Kaggle extracted each into a folder named after the zip (E: package copy: mavceleb_v1_complete-001/{meta_v1.csv, v1/})

inputs.note: FF_DATA/00_raw/mavceleb_v1_v2_zips/ (the two zips; keep them OUTSIDE the extracted dataset folder)

kernel_layout._ff_raw_mavceleb/raw_mavceleb_check.json: report + resume markers (outside the dataset folder)

skip_with_note: the two extracted folders only (mavceleb_v1_complete-001/, mavceleb_v2_complete-002/); no zip inside: keep the zips in 00_raw/mavceleb_v1_v2_zips/

verify.check: zip sizes + sha256, file counts per release, meta_v1.csv sha256, no zip inside the dataset folder

notes: Both parent folders are kept as they are (mavceleb_v1_complete-001/, mavceleb_v2_complete-002/): stage r08_mav_rows finds the roots by their '/v1/' and '/v2/' folders, and the RFS LoRA C1 run (t163l_orig, kaggle/build_flag163.py:93) stops at the first v1 / v2 folder it meets, so a different layout could change what C1 learned (DESIGN §4.1, G8).

Release content (central directory read 18/11/2026): v1 = meta_v1.csv + v1/ (302 492 jpg, 19 556 wav; 2 337 directory entries); v2 = v2/ (371 626 jpg, 20 715 wav; 2 767 directory entries). mavceleb_v1_train-004.zip is not used.

A saved copy of the extracted dataset (raw class: always taken from FF_DATA, so this stage does not run then) is checked by stage raw_mavceleb_check (outputs.verifies), which the runner schedules before the first MAV consumer.
changes_summary: new: cells/00_locate.py .. 02_check.py (whole stage): new: zip sha256 check, zipfile extraction into the folder named after each zip, file-count / layout check

build.cell_filter: orig = index of the cell in the original notebook's nb['cells'] list (markdown cells counted; the cell must be a non-empty code cell), CRLF->LF; new: cells/*.py (each opens with print("[cell] ...", flush=True))

cells.title: raw_mavceleb: locate and check the two original MAV-Celeb zips
raw_mavceleb: extract each zip into the folder named after it (= Kaggle's auto-extraction)
raw_mavceleb: count files and check the layout of the dataset folder

schema: DESIGN.md §2.2 (+ build, notes, changes_summary, outputs.kernel_layout / aliases / scratch / saved_copy)
